english.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for a designated zone or area with a particular use or rule.

examples.english: This is the smoking zone, so you can smoke here.
examples.traditional: 呢個係吸煙區，所以你可以喺度食煙。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 kap1 jin1 keoi1 so2 ji5 nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 dou6 sik6 jin1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an administrative district or a named area defined by a feature.
Use this for an administrative district within a city or borough, such as Tokyo's Chiyoda Ward.

examples.english: This district gets very lively at night.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 keoi1 je6 maan5 hou2 jit6 naau6

examples.english: Chiyoda Ward is in central Tokyo.
examples.traditional: 千代田區喺東京市中心。
examples.jyutping: cin1 doi6 tin4 keoi1 hai2 dung1 ging1 si5 zung1 sam1
